payload.title: Scaffold the publication repository in the Anth.us shape
payload.description: Next.js CMS app depending on @anthusai/papyrus 3.2.0 (generic `papyrus` theme pack, newspaper-gothic Kanbus theme), `papyrus.config.ts` with `backend.publication` = s3-projection (`web/projector.py`, staticDir `web`, CloudFront distribution created by the backend, reprojectOnDeploy), `amplify/` re-exports, `amplify.yml`, `infra/site.json` and `infra/package.json`, newsroom sections in `corpora/` (TTAB Rulings, Commentary, The Wire), package-lock. Typechecks against 3.2.0; the publication block passes Papyrus's `validatePublicationConfig`. Note: the zod override is pinned to `^3.25.76` instead of `$zod`, which npm could not resolve without an existing lockfile.
